# Plugin.Maui.FormValidation

Mobile-first form validation for .NET MAUI: fluent rules, conditional / async / server checks, and Validation.For attached-property bindings.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.FormValidation
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.FormValidation
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-form-validation
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+), net10.0-maccatalyst (15+), net10.0-windows (10.0.17763+; packed on Windows)

Platforms: Android, iOS, Mac Catalyst, and Windows. The Windows TFM is included when the package is packed on Windows.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.FormValidation

Registration: `UseMauiFormValidation` (optional) — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I validate a MAUI form without scattering if checks?
- MAUI Entry validation / email / phone / required fields
- Conditional, async, or server-side form validation in .NET MAUI

## Do not use when

- The team already standardizes on FluentValidation or DataAnnotations and does not need MAUI attached-property UX
